retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s pop aesthetic featuring a split-panel composition with rounded-corner frames, vibrant color blocking, and a mix of condensed sans-serif and high-contrast serif typography.
triggerTerms: vintage teal and magenta color scheme

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured layout divided into two primary vertical rounded-corner capsules against a cream background. The left capsule contains a studio portrait of a subject in denim, while the right capsule features a solid teal background with centered typography. A large display header sits at the top, and a circular badge overlaps the top-left corner of the image frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between the image capsule and the text capsule
Overlapping circular badge breaking the rigid frame of the left capsule
Contrast between the warm cream background and the cool teal/blue interior panels
Hierarchical scale from the large top header down to the fine-print tracklist
coreInvariants: Rounded-corner rectangular frames with thin black outlines
Subject in a high-key studio setting with a solid color floor/backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered within the left rounded capsule, shown from the waist up in a kneeling pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large magenta display text at the top acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top header to left image, then to the circular badge, then across to the teal text panel, ending at the bottom logo area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial cream-colored margins around the central capsules provide breathing room.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal (Right Panel) and Denim Blue (Left Image)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents against a muted, low-value cream base.

letterConstructionRules: Display text is ultra-condensed with tight tracking
Secondary titles use high-contrast serifs with vertical stress
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold sans-serif for impact paired with elegant high-contrast serifs for sophistication.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangle frames with double outlines
Horizontal divider lines with diamond ornaments
Interlocking colored rings at the bottom

preserve: High contrast of the serif titles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, bold display header style.
Captures the high-contrast, vertical stress of the secondary titles.
Suitable for the all-caps sans-serif body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with two vertical rounded-corner capsules. The left capsule contains a 1960s-style studio portrait of a woman with a blonde beehive hairstyle wearing a denim shirt against a blue backdrop. The right capsule is solid teal. Add a circular white badge overlapping the top-left of the image capsule.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed magenta sans-serif text at the top. Inside the teal panel, add centered white high-contrast serif text for the main title and smaller all-caps sans-serif text for the list below. Add magenta serif text inside the circular badge.

verificationChecks: Are the frames rounded rectangles with thin outlines?
Is the header text ultra-condensed and magenta?
Is the right panel solid teal with centered white text?
Does a circular badge overlap the left image frame?

adjustableVariables: Color of the right panel (e.g., orange, yellow)
Subject pose and attire in the left panel
Accent color for the header and badge
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all geometric frames

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rounded corners of the capsules are consistent.
Check that the circular badge is perfectly round and overlaps the frame.
Verify the typography hierarchy: Header > Title > List.
Confirm the color palette remains within the 1960s retro spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-capsule layout + 1960s studio portrait + condensed sans-serif header + high-contrast serif titles + cream/teal/magenta palette.
